quote: “Don’t kill that fly! / Look—it’s wringing its hands, / wringing its feet.”
source: Kobayashi Issa, ‘Don’t kill that fly!’, The Essential Haiku, Issa section (trans. Robert Hass, 1994)

evidence.where: Modern American Poetry (maps-legacy.org) excerpt of Hass on Issa, printed with the Ecco Press 1994 permission credit naming this haiku; corroborated by two blogs transcribing the Issa section
evidence.edition: The Essential Haiku: Versions of Basho, Buson, and Issa, ed. and trans. Robert Hass (Ecco, 1994)
evidence.locator: Issa section; also quoted in the Introduction

reason: Hass’s three lines match the proposal word for word, including the dash and the repeated wringing; the Ecco copyright credit on the page ties the text to the 1994 book. The archive.org scan is lending-only so no page number is given.
